changedFactors: network-only fixed first-training span; current minimum
side channel constant zero; same endpoint side/group sampler
primaryMetric: mean late IGD from trapezoidal integral FE 50000..100000 using 1000-FE cached trajectory
selection: Choose lower across-run mean log(lateIGDAUC / original) among stable arms; require ratio < 1 to nominate a confirmatory candidate. Do not retune on confirmation seeds. If neither improves, report negative intervention evidence, no claimed solution.

noveltyMetric.reference: all short pairs present at 50000 FE
noveltyMetric.interpretation: proxy from true opposite-label short pairs, not proof of unexplored global boundary

invariants: No new network or coordinate context
No changes to P1/P2 proportions and selection
No production default switch during comparison
